utility.notes: SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (updated 3/17/2025) explicitly lists 'Brea' by name among the cities in its service area.

generation_supplier.notes: Orange County Power Authority (OCPA), the CCA operating in Orange County, currently names Buena Park, Fullerton, Irvine, and Fountain Valley as members — Brea was not named among current members this session. Left null rather than asserted either way.

county.notes: Brea is a well-documented Orange County city; also listed under Orange County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Brea/Orange County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value.name: Completed City of Brea building permit application

value: Schedule inspections through the Online Permit Center or call Building & Safety at 714-990-7600

value.program_or_pathway: SolarAPP+ (standard residential rooftop solar and energy storage systems) / traditional submittal (ineligible systems)
other_conditions: Only roof-mounted retrofit photovoltaic systems meeting the SolarAPP+ Eligibility Checklist qualify for automated processing
Ineligible systems must use traditional submittal procedures through the Online Permit Center

permit_fees.notes: The page states SolarAPP+ charges a processing fee covering up to three revisions, but no dollar amount is given.
